/bin/bash -lc 'set -eu
work_tmp=$(find "${TMPDIR}" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '"'svsu-verify.*' | sort | tail -1)
printf '%s\\n' \"using "'$work_tmp"
for item in engineering medical overall pharmacy; do
  url="https://www.nirfindia.org/Rankings/2025/${item''^}RankingALL.html"
  out="$work_tmp/nirf_$item.html"
  curl -L --insecure --fail --show-error --silent --max-time 60 "$url" -o "$out"
  printf '"'%s\\n' \"--- "'$item ---"
  rg -i -m 5 -C 2 '"'Swami Vivekanand|Subharti' \""'$out" || true
done
for host in '"'www.subharti.org' 'subharti.org' 'svsu.ac.in' 'www.svsu.ac.in'; do
  out=\""'$work_tmp/${host//./_}.html"
  url="https://$host/"
  curl -L --insecure --fail --show-error --silent --max-time 60 "$url" -o "$out" || true
  printf '"'%s %s bytes\\n' \""'$url" "$(wc -c < "$out" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  rg -i -m 4 -C 1 '"'Swami Vivekanand|Subharti|Meerut' \""'$out" 2>/dev/null || true
done'

306:SWAMI VIVEKANAND SUBHARTI UNIVERSITY
311:These inspiring words are the immortal words of Swami Vivekananda, one of the most celebrated spiritual leaders of India, a spiritual genius of commanding intellect and power, who introduced Indian Philosophy of Vedanta & Yoga to the West, and whom (Swami Vivekanand) Subharti University is named after.
313:Swami Vivekanand Subharti University (SVSU) is a university under the section 2(f) of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956, set up under the Swami Vivekanand Subharti Vishwavidyalaya; Uttar Pradesh Adhiniyam, 2008 (UP Act No. 29 of 2008) as passed by the Uttar Pradesh Legislature and assented to by the Honorable Governor of Uttar Pradesh in September 2008.
315:SVSU was established with a dream of making self-confident and dynamic young people who are not only professionally competent but also fully aware of their duty to the society and the nation. The institution is committed to the mission of helping young minds thrive and realize their full potential.
317:SVSU has been granted the accreditation rating of ‘Grade A’ by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC). The University, that houses 18 colleges offering more than 220 professional programs, is one of the premier universities of the country with an international acclaim for its highest academic standards, diverse courses, distinguished faculty, varied co-curricular activities and state-of-the-art infrastructure.
319:The lush green campus, which is aptly called ‘Subhartipuram’, covers a vast area of about 250 acres. Magnificent buildings with busy individuals moving around, classrooms with immense enthusiasm for learning, labs with endless quest for innovation, libraries with relentless pursuit of knowledge, playgrounds buzzing with energy, packed auditoriums with outstanding performances – the whole campus is truly a hive of activity.
321:Highly qualified and dedicated teachers at SVSU make serious efforts to bridge the gap between theoretical and practical learning, work tirelessly to create the right skill sets that today’s employers look for, thus making students industry-ready. With more than 130,000 alumni, the University has an excellent placement record with increasing number of students getting placed every year.
323:SVSU has some distinctive features which are well worth mentioning. It follows environmentally sound practices, e.g. Use of Solar Panels & Rainwater Harvesting System, Tree Planting, Car Free Days, etc. It offers and successfully runs 220+ courses. It is known as a great centre of Buddhist Studies. The University honors the unsung heroes of Indian Freedom Struggle and martyrs of the nation in its own unique way – Shaheed Smaraka; a museum devoted to the life & struggle of Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose; Kargil Shaheed Upvan where each tree has been planted in memory of every soldier who laid down his life during the 1999 Kargil War; every College, Road & all the buildings within the campus has been named in honor of an Indian nationalist or an Indian revolutionary. /bin/bash -lc 'set -eu

cat > \""'$work_tmp/admission_urls.txt" <<'"'EOF'

https://subharti.org/lib-info-science-admission.html
https://subharti.org/polytechnic-admission.html
EOF
: > \""'$work_tmp/admission_fetch.tsv"
while IFS= read -r url; do
  host=$(printf '"'%s' \""'$url" | sed -E '"'s#https://(["'^/]+)/.*#'"\\1#')
  slug="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$url" | sed -E '"'s#https://["'^/]+/##; s#[/?=&]#_#g'"')
  [ -n \""'$slug" ] || slug=index
  out="$work_tmp/admission_${slug}.html"
  txt="$work_tmp/admission_${slug}.txt"
  if curl -L --insecure --fail --show-error --silent --max-time 60 "$url" -o "$out"; then
    pandoc --from html --to plain --wrap=none "$out" -o "$txt" || true
    title=$(rg -m1 -i '"'"'^ *#? *(.*(Admission|Faculty|College|University).*)$'"' \""'$txt" | sed '"'s/"'^ *//'"' | cut -c1-160 || true)
    printf '%s\\t%s\\t%s\\n' \""'$url" "$(wc -c < "$out")" "$title" >> "$work_tmp/admission_fetch.tsv"
  else
    printf '"'%s\\tFAILED\\t\\n' \""'$url" >> "$work_tmp/admission_fetch.tsv"
  fi
done < "$work_tmp/admission_urls.txt"
cat "$work_tmp/admission_fetch.tsv"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- extracted programme/eligibility lines ---'
for txt in \""'$work_tmp"/admission_*.txt; do

Faculty of Engineering & Technology is the nation’s premier career-oriented college of engineering. The Institute aims to educate the budding technocrats to become designers, producers and efficient users of technology. The undergraduate curricula emphasize fundamentals and provide courses that allow students to specialize in their chosen fields of study. Thus, students are well prepared to be immediately valuable contributors to their employers.

Technology has had an ever-increasing impact on our lives and the technologist of tomorrow will need to be lifelong learners with a wider scope of knowledge and work than ever before. We at Faculty of Engineering & Technology specialize in delivering innovative, industry-focused programmes that reflect the modern global economy and develop highly marketable and advanced skills needed to manage and lead anywhere in the world.

To meet the desire and demand for excellence, quality and aesthetics in technology and uncompromising standards and methodology, Faculty of Engineering & Technology has an advisory board with whom students meet regularly to ensure that academic programs are providing a curriculum that is current with industry needs and standards. These boards also help the college identify external funding opportunities and support. Renowned academicians from across the country are members of the Research Committee that approves the topics for researchers and recommends the award of the Engineering degree.

B.Tech Course (CSE, IT, EC, EEE, ME, CE) and M.Tech Courses (CSE, Cyber Security, RF and Microwave, Power Electronics and Drives, Production Engineering, Environmental Engineering and Management, PhD in ME, CSE, EEE, EE) are AICTE approved.

The 8 Semester UG program, 4 Semester PG Course and Doctorate Programs in engineering fields aim at giving a broad introduction to the sciences and an introduction to hands-on engineering. These semesters are designed to provide enough tools and knowledge in the chosen stream to enable the student to pick up current technologies in his place of work after completion of his degree course.

The Career Service aims to develop our students interpersonally and professionally. The curriculum is designed to encourage the development of highly marketable skills, thereby enhancing their career prospects and giving them the tools they need to secure the job of their dreams. The Faculty of Engineering & Technology wants the student to cherish jobs where they can make full use of their skills and qualifications and derive benefits from their learning programs. To achieve the best placements, we work closely with industry-leading employers and help the students to win a good job profile.

Introduction

Sardar Patel Subharti Institute of Law (SARPA-SIL) i.e. Subharti Law College (Faculty of Law, Swami Vivekanand Subharti University, Meerut) is among one of the top colleges of Law in the State of Uttar Pradesh. Subharti Law College was started in the year 2002. The Bar Council of India, under the Advocates Act 1961, duly accorded its approval to the University and the latest approval has been given vide its letter no. BCI: D: 328/2020 (LE/App/Afflin), 30.07.2020 to run the various academic courses under the Faculty of Law.

The College was established in the pious memory of Sardar Patel, first Home Minister, First Deputy Prime Minister, an eminent lawyer and the Iron Man of India. The magnificent building of Sardar Patel Subharti Institute of Law is located in lush green surroundings, with spacious and well-furnished smart classrooms, equipped with necessary instructional Aids such as overhead projector, whiteboards, Smart Boards, Microphones and LCD Projector for effective communication and interaction with the students, to facilitate smart classroom discussion and project presentation. It prides itself in possessing a rich Library with I.T. and Wi-Fi facilities, a vibrant campus and excellent faculty which makes it one of the selected institutions which impart quality legal education in India.

Moreover, the whole college is Wi-Fi empowered with a 24x7 internet connection. It has a Moot Court Hall designed like a courtroom to conduct Moot Court Training and Competitions. The programme seeks to promote multi-disciplinary analysis of the socio-legal problems by designing its course structure and teaching methods to realize these objectives. The methods of teaching in the Sardar Patel Subharti Institute of Law include lectures, discussions, case law analysis, moot court training, project assignments, free legal aid camps, internship programmes and placement opportunities. Furthermore, the college organizes National/International Seminars and Conferences on contemporary socio-political-legal issues, conducts clinical courses and trains students in legal research and legal writing. By the time a student completes his/her five-year programme, he/she will be fully versed with the required subject knowledge and practical experience in the field of law to become a full-fledged responsible member of the legal profession.

Twelve Batches of B.A.LL.B., Eight batches of LL.M. & Five Batches of M. Phil have already passed out and every student is successfully professing as lawyers or judges in either the Supreme Court of India, various High Courts, District Courts or with LPOs and MNCs, Corporate Legal Departments etc.
